title: 'When this is ... killed, draw 1' does not trigger
expected: Scrapheap has no hand-written abilities (riftbound-cards/src/cards/ogn/scrapheap.ts) so it is enriched via parseAbilities, which maps "When this is played, discarded, or killed," to synthetic event "play-discard-or-die-self" (riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/trigger-patterns.ts:271). The engine's triggerMatchesEvent splits trigger.event on "-or-" (riftbound-engine/src/abilities/trigger-matcher.ts:218-228) yielding ["play-discard","die-self"], neither of which equals the fired "die" (or "play-self"/"discard") event, so the trigger never matches. Confirmed by src/__tests__/cards/ogn-182-298.test.ts:58 test.failing (killed branch) passing as expected-failing when run.
observed: Scrapheap moved to trash, player-1 deck 35->33 and hand +2 only (Detonate's draws); no Scrapheap trigger on chain

history.note: already fixed upstream: trigger-patterns uses engine event names for the -or- split; killed branch passes

resolution.note: already fixed upstream: trigger-patterns uses engine event names for the -or- split; killed branch passes
